semantics: A census adapter is a versioned, reviewable mapping from one estate source model into the generic exact performer-role observation contract. Registration does not certify, activate, lease, or publish an estate.

semantic_controls: full-canon discovery remains separate from category sampling
exact performer-role identity survives category overlap
voice-only and physical performances remain distinguishable
unknown performer or role never becomes absence or ineligibility
adapters.next_gate: Retain Star Trek as the frozen reference adapter while extracting only the contract shared by a separately regenerated second estate.

semantic_controls: plain-text names are admitted only inside the closed performer-field set
target identity requires numbered species fields or an exact target-bearing title
explicit non-target species is out of scope and category membership is never performer evidence
voice-actor fields map to voice while generic actor fields retain unresolved designed-form mode
unparseable non-empty trusted fields stop publication rather than silently disappearing
adapters.next_gate: Run complete current-source smoke, then issue a separate second-desk certification or retain an explicit blocked disposition.
